title: massive_extended_hours record
description: One common stock's pre-market and after-hours activity for one day, summed from Massive 1-minute bars (adjusted). Sessions by bar start time in New York: pre-market 04:00-09:29, regular 09:30 to the close (16:00, 13:00 on half days), after-hours from the close minute to 19:59. Daily volume in daily_summary already covers the whole day and is larger than the three volumes here by the auction and other prints that are in no minute bar.

pre_market_price.description: First pre-market price: the open of the first bar before 09:30 (Massive open-close preMarket). Null with no pre-market trades.

pre_market_last.description: Last pre-market price: the close of the last bar before 09:30.

regular_volume.description: Shares in the regular-session 1-min bars (09:30 to the close). Lower than daily volume: auction prints are in no minute bar.

after_hours_price.description: Last after-hours price: the close of the last bar from the close minute on (Massive open-close afterHours).

after_hours_volume.description: Shares traded from the close minute to 19:59 (sum of 1-min bars, the 16:00 minute included).

fetched_at.description: When the bars were fetched (UTC ISO). Split adjustment is as of this time.
